text:
maria (PM): Quick sync — want to frame a roadmap slice for Dedicated around 'elastic lanes' (new name for burst+isolation) and the SLA/eviction story. Agenda: define lane semantics, minimal autoscale policy, SLA targets, eviction/gentle-degrade behavior, and a beta checklist. Thoughts?

nate (eng-runtime): +1 on a distinct concept. 'Elastic lanes' helps communicate that capacity can be preferential + opportunistic. Key engineering constraint: we need a deterministic eviction signal. Right now we only have node-level memory pressure and GPU queue length.

jade (eng-sre): Deterministic signal is must-have for any SLA promise. Suggestion: combine two signals — queue latency crossing p95 threshold AND GPU utilization > 92% for 20s. Only then mark lane as 'oversubscribed'.

maria (PM): Good. For MVP launch criteria I propose: p95 latency under SLA target when not oversubscribed, <1 soft-eviction per 100k requests, transparent billing for burst usage, and canary with 2 customers. Agree?

sam (product-ops): We also need admin-facing controls: (1) per-account lane priority (low/standard/guaranteed), (2) eviction grace window config, (3) opt-in burst cap. Minimal UI is fine.

leo (sales): For enterprise deals, customers will ask for guaranteed isolation for specific workloads. We should map 'guaranteed' -> reserved lanes (no preemption) and 'elastic' -> opportunistic with clear SLO. Sales needs a one-page matrix to explain tradeoffs.

nate (eng-runtime): Implementation sketch for autoscale policy (MVP):
```yaml
lane: elastic
min_instances: 2
max_instances: 20
scale_policy:
  - trigger: p95_queue_latency > 150ms for 30s
    action: add_instance
  - trigger: gpu_util > 92% for 20s
    action: mark_oversubscribed
eviction_policy:
  - type: soft_eviction
    grace_period: 60s
    fallback_lane: standard
```
This keeps it simple and observable.

jade (eng-sre): For soft_eviction we should add a health-check probe to evicted requests so the app can retry gracefully. Also log an event with reason and token counts for billing reconciliation.

maria (PM): Launch must-haves vs stretch:
- Must: deterministic oversubscribe signal, soft_eviction with grace, billing delta for burst, SLA text for guaranteed lanes.
- Stretch: autoscale predictive model, cross-region bursting, per-route priority.

leo (sales): Can we get a one-page SLA draft for guaranteed vs elastic? Even a bullet list is fine — I'll use it in upcoming customer calls.

sam (product-ops): I'll draft the beta checklist. Items: end-to-end telemetry (p50/p95/p99), eviction audit logs, billing delta test, two beta customers signed, runbook for evictions, console controls.

nate (eng-runtime): Risk notes: eviction correctness across mixed model families (large-context vs short) — KV caching complicates eviction. We'll need test harness to validate behavior across model variants.

maria (PM): OK owners: nate = runtime implementation and test harness, jade = SRE observability & runbooks, sam = beta checklist and console stubs, leo = customer communications. Action: nate and jade, can you produce design + risk doc by EOW (1812400000)?

nate (eng-runtime): Will do. I'll post a short design doc in #eng-runtime and link back here.

jade (eng-sre): I'll put initial dashboards + alert thresholds up and wire the audit logs to a retention bucket.

deploy-bot: New draft deploy pipeline created for feature/elastic-lanes. See CI job: `deploy/elastic-lanes/beta` :package: :rocket:

maria (PM): Thanks all — will consolidate and prioritize in the roadmap board. If anyone has urgent objections to must-have list, flag now. Otherwise we'll move forward with the MVP scope. :thumbsup:
